Charged, nitro, fused-nitrogen, sulfur, and heteroaromatic rows probe atom environments that are sparse or poorly transferred from neutral chemistry. High-width V2 candidates target completion and interval-width behavior directly, while low-ratio anchors prevent sampling only the retained tail.
